# clerk_organization_permission (Resource)

Manages a Clerk organization permission.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "clerk_organization_permission" "example" {
  name        = "Create posts"
  key         = "org:posts:create"
  description = "Allows creating posts within the organization"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Unique key for the permission (e.g. org:posts:create).
- `name` (String) Display name of the permission.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of what the permission allows.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the permission was created.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the organization permission.
- `type` (String) Type of the permission (system or user).
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the permission was last updated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import clerk_organization_permission.example <organization_permission_id>
```
